title: Trump’s AI testing plan is limited and vague
slides: Will Trump's AI plan actually define safety?
It only outlines voluntary testing for some models.
Neither enforcement nor clear standards are included.
Developers lack concrete rules to follow or measure.
Pressure your representatives to demand real requirements.
thread_text:
1. What's Missing?

The new AI plan skips enforcement, leaving developers free to ignore safety rules.

2. Voluntary Only

No mandatory testing means companies decide if they want to comply—most won't.

3. No Yardstick

Without clear standards, there's no way to measure if an AI model is actually safe.

4. The Gap

Regulators have no legal basis to act if something goes wrong—just hope.

5. Your Move

Call your representative today and ask: "Will you enforce real AI safety rules?"

script: Trump's AI plan lacks real safety.

instagram.caption:
The new AI testing plan won’t require a single company to prove its model is safe before launching 🧪

It’s voluntary, covers only *some* models, and includes zero enforcement or clear standards. So there’s no legal way to stop a harmful rollout, and no yardstick to measure what “safe” even means.

If you write or publish with AI tools, this means the rules governing them stay optional—and your work could be disrupted by an unsafe model with no recourse.

Are you okay relying on companies to self-regulate, or will you ask your representative to demand mandatory standards? 📞

carousel_slides.description: Trump’s plan lacks enforcement and clear standards, leaving AI safety undefined. Without a yardstick, no one can measure if models are truly safe.
The plan only suggests voluntary checks for some models, so companies can opt out. Most will, leaving risks unaddressed.
Without concrete standards, developers have nothing to measure against. A model passes or fails based on nothing—just guesswork.
When something goes wrong, there’s no legal basis to act. The gap leaves the public hoping, not protected.
Demand real AI safety rules. Call your representative today and ask if they’ll enforce mandatory testing and clear standards.
